references.text: Jesus gives his twelve disciples power to drive out unclean spirits
Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse lepers, drive out demons
Jesus gives the twelve power and authority over all demons and to heal diseases
The seventy-two return with joy, saying that even demons submit to them in Jesus' name
Also those who were troubled by unclean spirits were healed
Unclean spirits go out of many who cry out loudly
Paul drives out a spirit of divination from a girl
